The present split is the standard furigana alignment of the compound (か is a listed day-counter reading of 日, as in 三日 みっか, 四日 よっか, 五日 いつか, and ふつ is the assimilated native two- base that appears only before that counter), and the sentence kana ふつかぶん and romaji are correct either way. The residual risk that a learner reads 二 = ふつ as a standalone reading is handled by the new note on tokens[7] rather than by inventing a different reading.

edits.new: A frase tem a estrutura básica de identificação 'X は Y です' (Isto é Y). O Y aqui é 'chave' (鍵), mas vem precedido de uma oração relativa: 'その箱をあける' (que abre essa caixa). Note que dentro dessa oração, '箱' (caixa) é o objeto de 'あける', marcado por を.
